judged_text: The embed_category lookup executes `[0]['id']` on a query result that is empty whenever the embed_category site setting row is absent or its value matches no category name, so `db:migrate` raises NoMethodError (undefined method `[]` for nil) and aborts the deploy. Every existing install that never explicitly set embed_category — and every fresh install, where the row cannot exist — fails this migration and cannot upgrade; the uncategorized fallback at lines 14-16 is unreachable because the crash preempts it and the join can never return id 0.
